贏得去倫敦念書的獎學金是個絕佳的機會，我興奮得睡不著。

fantastic claims: The salesman made fantastic claims, saying his magic water could cure every disease and help people live to 200.

farther down the road: This gas station is closed, but there is another one a little farther down the road on the left.
這間加油站關了，不過再往前走一段路，左手邊還有另一間。

fashionable ideas: The young designer is always open to fashionable ideas that are popular among teenagers on social media.

a fatal mistake: Driving after drinking even one glass of wine can be a fatal mistake that costs someone their life.
即使只喝一杯酒就開車，也可能是個賠上人命的致命錯誤。
a fatal flaw: The plan had a fatal flaw: nobody had checked whether the bridge could hold that much weight, so it failed completely.
這個計畫有個致命的缺陷：沒人檢查橋能否承受那麼重的重量，所以完全失敗了。
a fatal accident: Three people died in a fatal accident on the highway last night when a truck crashed into two cars.
昨晚高速公路上一輛卡車撞上兩部車，造成三人死亡的死亡事故。
prove fatal: Without quick treatment, a bite from this snake can prove fatal within just a few hours.
若沒有及時治療，被這種蛇咬到在短短幾小時內就可能結果致命。
a favorable impression: Her polite manners and careful answers made a favorable impression on the interviewers, and she got the job.
她有禮的舉止和謹慎的回答給面試官留下了好印象，她得到了那份工作。
favorable conditions: Warm weather and plenty of rain provide favorable conditions for rice to grow quickly in southern Taiwan.
溫暖的天氣和充足的雨水為台灣南部的稻米快速生長提供了有利的條件。
a favorable response: The new menu received a favorable response from customers, so the restaurant decided to keep it all year.
新菜單得到顧客正面的回應，所以餐廳決定全年供應。
favorable terms: The bank offered us a loan on favorable terms, with a very low interest rate and no extra fees.
銀行以優惠條件貸款給我們，利率很低而且沒有額外費用。
compare favorably with: Our school's test results compare favorably with those of other schools in the city; we ranked near the top.

許多學生害怕作弊的後果，所以考試時從不嘗試抄答案。
a fearful storm: A fearful storm hit the island last night, tearing roofs off houses and knocking down hundreds of trees.
昨晚一場可怕的暴風雨襲擊這座島，掀翻了房屋屋頂，還吹倒了數百棵樹。
be fearful that…: Many parents are fearful that their children spend too much time online and may become addicted to games.
許多父母擔心孩子上網時間太長，可能會沉迷於遊戲。
the federal government: In the United States, the federal government in Washington makes decisions about matters such as national defense.
在美國，位於華盛頓的聯邦政府負責決定國防等事務。
federal law: Under federal law, every state in the US must follow the same basic rules about workers' safety.

fertile soil: Farmers along the river grow plenty of vegetables because the fertile soil there is rich in nutrients.
河邊的農夫種了大量蔬菜，因為那裡肥沃的土壤富含養分。
a fertile imagination: The writer has a fertile imagination and can create a whole new world full of magic and strange creatures.
這位作家有豐富的想像力，能創造出一個充滿魔法和奇異生物的全新世界。
fertile ground for: Crowded, dirty cities with poor water can be fertile ground for diseases to spread quickly.
擁擠、骯髒又缺乏乾淨用水的城市可能成為疾病迅速傳播的溫床。

fierce competition: There is fierce competition for places at top universities, so many students study hard until midnight every day.

a fierce debate: The new school rule caused a fierce debate, with students and teachers arguing angrily for hours.

fierce resistance: The soldiers met fierce resistance from local people who refused to give up their homes without a fight.
士兵們遭到當地居民頑強的抵抗，他們拒絕不戰而放棄家園。

fierce loyalty: The dog showed fierce loyalty to its owner, barking wildly at any stranger who came too close to her.
